name: CA-01
label: Likely D

key_factors: Post-redistricting fundamentals strongly favor Democrats (D+7 PVI plus a favorable environment)
Prediction markets price the Democrat at roughly 95% to win
Republican incumbent James Gallagher faces a well-funded challenger in Mike McGuire, who has outraised him and drawn outside support
No public general-election polling, leaving the forecast dependent on fundamentals
model.rationale: The redrawn district leans Democratic and the political environment points the same way, while markets price McGuire as a heavy favorite. Gallagher's incumbency and his fundraising edge in cash on hand keep the forecast from moving further, but the fundamentals dominate.
model.watch: Any polling showing Gallagher consolidating incumbent support, or a shift in the national environment toward Republicans, could narrow this considerably.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; fundamentals point clearly one way (post-redistricting), so it is treated as safe for that party.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
California's first district was redrawn after the 2020 cycle and now leans Democratic by about seven points on the partisan vote index. Republican incumbent James Gallagher, who advanced to the general election, faces Democratic state senator Mike McGuire in a seat whose new fundamentals favor the other party.

McGuire has raised more money overall and benefits from outside support, though Gallagher holds more cash on hand. Prediction markets price McGuire as a strong favorite, and no public general-election polling is available to contradict the fundamentals-based picture, which points clearly toward a Democratic pickup.
